## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode #13190: CLI environment details separation — improve prompt-cache hit ratio (MODERATE ~4h)

- **What**: Separate `<environment_details>` block from user prompt text by prefixing it with blank lines (e.g. `\n\n<environment_details>...`). Apply same separation to switch/plan reminder blocks. Update prompt-cache detection (`applyCaching`) to trim leading whitespace before matching block start tags like `<environment_details>`. Without separation, user-authored prompt text directly abuts the env block, which varies per message (working directory, file paths, timestamp) and prevents caching the stable baseline. With separation, the cacheable prefix ends at a stable boundary (last user text line) and the env block becomes a distinct, cache-friendly suffix. Also prevents duplicate block injection: env-block skip-check used raw `startsWith('<environment_details>')`, which failed when blank lines preceded the block, allowing repeated loop iterations to append duplicates.
- **Why**: Improves prompt-cache hit ratio for Claude models (cache hits save latency + cost). Prevents duplicate env-block injection. Better prompt hygiene.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13190 (fix(cli): separate environment details from user prompt text)
- **Category**: command
- **Size**: MODERATE (~4h — Alexi injects `<environment_details>` in `src/cli/interactive.ts` and `src/core/sessionContext.ts`. Audit injection sites: if env block is directly concatenated to user text without blank-line prefix, add `\n\n` separator. Search for prompt-cache logic (`applyCaching` or cache-control headers): update block-detection regex to `startsWith` after trimming leading whitespace. Add test coverage for duplicate-block prevention. Straightforward fix, but requires auditing multiple injection sites and updating cache detection.)

#### 2. Cline #13752: Scheduled runs grouping in sidebar — desktop UI feature (LOW priority, SKIP)

- **What**: Desktop app sidebar groups scheduled sessions by schedule instead of listing every run individually. Collapsible groups named after schedule, run count on right, runs listed as "Run N" sub-items (newest first) with status dot, time, hover card, context menu, delete button. Active session auto-expands its group. Metadata stamped at session creation: `scheduleId`, `scheduleName`, `scheduleExecutionId`, `scheduleRunNumber`. Runs without a number (pre-stamping) labelled with start time. Grouping also applies inside project groups when sorting by project. Scheduled header counts schedules, not runs. Collapse state stored per group, cleared when a run is opened.
- **Why**: Improves sidebar UX when a schedule fires daily (many runs with same prompt text looked like duplicates). Better organization.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13752 (feat(desktop): group scheduled runs under their schedule in the sidebar)
- **Category**: command (UI)
- **Size**: LOW priority, SKIP — Alexi is CLI-first, has no desktop app, no sidebar UI, no scheduled runs UI surface (sessions are file-based under `~/.alexi/sessions/`, no cron runner yet). Feature requires TUI/UI redesign beyond CLI scope. If scheduled runs land in Alexi later (via `src/core/task-scheduler.ts`), revisit this for grouping logic.

#### 3. Cline #13744: Session import from Claude Code / Codex / opencode — large UI-heavy feature (HIGH complexity ~12-16h, DEFER)

- **What**: Full session import pipeline. Discovery phase scans local stores: Claude Code `~/.claude/projects` JSONL with parentUuid tree walk (active branch = newest leaf, same-message.id assistant lines merge, sidechains/meta/slash-command wrappers excluded, ai-title/summary provide titles), Codex `~/.codex/sessions` rollouts with session_index (user_message event_msg = real prompts, function_call/output → tool_use/tool_result, resumed rollouts dedupe to richest file, token_count events stamp per-turn metrics), opencode `opencode.db` sqlite (temp WAL snapshot, inline tool parts split into tool_use + tool_result, child sessions + synthetic parts skipped). Shared sanitizer guarantees replayability: orphaned tool_use gets placeholder result, orphaned tool_results drop, empty text blocks drop, provider-session signatures/encrypted reasoning strip. Imported sessions terminal status, non-empty provider/model, chat-workspace fallback cwd, no fabricated checkpoint, metadata.importedFrom for idempotent dedupe (alreadyImportedSessionId). Two sidecar commands: `list_importable_sessions` (installedTools, sessions summary with tool/sourceId/title/cwd/timestamps/messageCount/preview/alreadyImportedSessionId), `import_sessions` (selections, sequential import, session_import_progress events). UI: Import button in Sessions view + Settings → General row, dialog with scan/filter/progress phases (per-tool groups with select-all, per-row title/time/message count/workspace, already-imported disabled + badged, text filter, collapsible sections, global Select all, progress bar + per-item results, error list). Onboarding step scans on entry, silently advances when nothing found, summarizes count + source tools, opens dialog, skip always available. Fixes: resolve resume target like new chat (getInitialChatConfig, never empty), batch adapters with per-batch caches (Codex session-id → richest-file index, opencode WAL snapshot), roll back failed imports, dedupe at import time (listSessionMetadata unbounded), create sessions terminal with source end time, importedFrom marker written last, consolidate tool_results into message after tool_use, edit-and-resend forks onto current workspace when no checkpoint exists, coalesce overlapping imports (in-flight map keyed by tool:sourceId), flatten Codex content-block tool outputs (concatenate text of input_text blocks).
- **Why**: Lets users migrate history from other tools. Reduces onboarding friction. Competitive feature (Claude Code, Codex, opencode all have large install bases).
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13744 (feat(desktop): import sessions from Claude Code, Codex, and opencode)
- **Category**: command + tool
- **Size**: HIGH complexity ~12-16h, DEFER — large surface area (3 adapters, sanitizer, dedupe, UI, sidecar commands, onboarding step, rollback, batch caching, resume target resolution, edit-and-resend without checkpoint), requires desktop UI / TUI redesign (Alexi is CLI-first, has no sidecar WebSocket surface, no import dialog, no onboarding flow). LOW priority until user requests it. If demand emerges, start with Claude Code JSONL adapter only (simplest: parentUuid tree walk, ai-title extraction, sanitizer — ~6h), then Codex rollouts (~4h), then opencode sqlite (~4h). UI deferred indefinitely until Alexi TUI redesign lands.
